title: Tic Tac pilots' names told to Bishop before release as a test

tellings.quote: I know you're telling me this cuz you see I'm going to leak stuff about the tic tac incident and pilots whose names hadn't been released yet. I was told don't talk about this.

plain: A UFO writer named Greg Bishop says he was told the names of the Navy pilots in the Tic Tac incident, the 2004 encounter with a white oval object shaped like the mint, before those names were made public, and that it was a test of whether he would leak them. The pilots were Alex Dietrich and David Fravor. Bishop, telling it as the person it happened to, says he guessed the point of it ("you see I'm going to leak stuff") and was told not to talk about it, which would mean people close to the story were checking who could keep a secret.
